title: Dashboard aggregation layer
description: Go API layer that composes per-dashboard payloads from the gap registry + per-source TTL cache + three upstream clients (Swarm Manager, Vrooli Core, LPBS).

requirements.title: Load gap registry at startup
requirements.description: config/gap-registry.json is decoded with DisallowUnknownFields; malformed JSON exits non-zero; valid files populate all 6 dashboards.

requirements.title: Per-source TTL cache with graceful degradation
requirements.description: cache.go enforces source-specific TTLs (Swarm 30s, Vrooli 60s, LPBS 5min) and surfaces staleness_ts on upstream error.

requirements.title: Upstream clients with LPBS gap-mode fallback
requirements.description: Uniform Client interface. Swarm and Vrooli are plain GET; LPBS attaches Bearer token and returns ErrNotAvailable on 404 so the scaffold is self-contained pre-LPBS endpoints.

requirements.title: Dashboards + gaps + debug handlers
requirements.description: GET /api/v1/dashboards/{id}, GET /api/v1/gaps, GET/POST /api/v1/debug/r3f-stats (ring buffer, 1024 cap, 1h TTL).
